decisions.reason: The offshore and renewables management unit is a strategic focus close to the core ship management business. Demand for offshore wind is growing, and the large, expanding firm has the slack to carry it, so no clear shortfall triggers problemistic search, even though the website is no longer observed.

Crew and corporate travel management is tied directly to the firm's large seafarer pools. It likely recovered after pandemic disruption to crew changes and is cheap to maintain, so it meets the modest aspirations set for a support service.

The online vessel information portal is a flagship digital offering that supports customer proximity and transparency for ship owners. It fits industry digitalisation trends, and its results are not visibly falling short, so management would keep and develop it.

The mobile performance app supports the firm's sustainability and efficiency direction and builds on existing systems. As a smaller digital add-on it could be folded into the portal, but slack and its strategic fit favour keeping it.
